text:
Predicates:
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for football club y.
Footballer(x) ::: x is a footballer.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
LoanedOut(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to club y.
Country(x, y) ::: x is a person from country y.
Club(y) ::: y is a football club.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
Premises:
Footballer(ailtonSilva) ::: Ailton Silva is a footballer.
BornIn(ailtonSilva, 1995) ::: Ailton Silva was born in 1995.
KnownAs(ailtonSilva, ailton) ::: Ailton Silva is known as Ailton.
LoanedOut(ailtonSilva, braga) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to Braga.
Country(ailtonSilva, brazil) ::: Ailton Silva is Brazilian.
PlaysFor(nautico, ailtonSilva) ::: Ailton Silva plays for Nautico.
PlaysFor(braga, ailtonSilva) ::: Ailton Silva plays for Braga.
Club(nautico) ::: Nautico is a football club.
Club(braga) ::: Braga is a football club.
Club(flu) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
¬PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, any) ::: Ailton Silva does not play for any football club.
